description:
Pop Tap – the perfect fidget toy puzzle game 

The party’s really popping in Pop US!, the pitch-perfect puzzle game where you put the jigsaw pieces together to make beautiful pictures, then just point your finger at the screen and pop, pop, pop! Merge the pieces to make your own DIY fidget toys, then dive into a world of relaxing ASMR pleasure as you pop every last bubble on the screen.

Get a burst of satisfying, colorful, antistress fun at your fingertips any time by downloading Pop US! to your device now!

title: Exploring the Galaxy 1: Andora
description: Exploring the Galaxy 1: Andora — free online game. Build a planet, gather resources, craft, unlock new lands. Play in browser, no download.

title: Jurassic Digging - Tycoon
description: The goal of the game is to uncover ancient remains, clean them from dirt, and assemble complete skeletons. Progress through all levels and provide museums with an extensive collection of dinosaur skeletons.

title: Cut It 3D
description:
In this game, you need to slice the obstacles in front of you! Tap to flip the knife and carefully cut the various obstacles in your path into equal halves! This is the juiciest way, become a knife master!

With your super sharp knife, no obstacle can stop you! Flip the knife over at the right moment and slice through various obstacles - pencils, pipes, anvils, and the list goes on!
You will need to keep the knife in the air at all times. You can even bounce off obstacles with the handle of the knife to flip back over and get more chances to cut!

title: Zombie Monster Survivors
description: In a world ravaged by a zombie virus, you are one of the last survivors. Each playthrough features randomly generated maps and enemies. Collect various weapons and items, upgrade your character's abilities, and survive as long as possible against waves of zombies.

title: Retro Run
description: Retro Run is a free to play pc game. Players must use A and D to navigate side to side to avoid some obstacles while using orbs to smash through others. Collect power-ups along the journey to get yourself out of sticky situations. But be careful! If you lose all your orbs, you will be forced to restart. Pressing space to recall orbs or smashing special crystals throughout the progression will restore balls. Can you make it to the end?

title: Music Note
description: Play as a music note jumping across platforms. Spread color with each bounce and bring life to a black-and-white world.

title: Catch the Snowmen!
description:
🎅🌨️ Touch the winter magic in the game "Catch the Snowmen!"

  🎁🎅You can feel like a real Santa Claus, creating nice and cute snowmen. Have fun creating a huge crowd of cute snowmen

🌲🎄Meet New Year's toys at each level that can be hung on a magical Christmas tree!

💪🔥 Each completed level allows you to improve the abilities of your brave snowmen and acquire new heroes in your team. Who are you - Santa Claus or the Grinch?

🎅👊Collect magical items and unlock unique abilities to face the real challenge of the game - the Giant and Evil Santa as the boss

✨🎉The more snowmen you have, the higher your place in the player ranking. Be the first! ❄️

title: Animal Basketball
description:
Basketball games: The Power of Moe! Ultra-healing hand-painted physical shooting party

[Moe Animal Troupe Gathering] 
Manipulation will be serious kittens, cute chicks, naughty crocodiles! The cute characters come with their own exclusive shooting action, each action can trigger the screen heartbeat warning! 

[Visual Feast Blitz sports games]
● Hoop game  with 100+ kinds of magical basketballs and special effects: pizza ball, fishbowl ball, baseball, etc. 
● 4 healing courts: beach by the sea, countryside at sunset, deep forest, and dangerous cliffs - every basket will play tricks!

[Triple Pleasure Mode] 
Arcade Rampage: 60-second adrenaline challenge! Combo effects are stacked, full-screen blow-up effects are cool!
Road to the Championship: Challenge how many throws without missing it.
Achievement Mission: 200 missions! Unlock outrageous medals such as “Board Wipe King” and “God Pitcher” 

[Physics Ghostly Moments] 
Real Physics Engine x Moe's Magic Modification! The wall clock can also be used to shoot baskets!

Call your friends and have a healing and addictive fingertip hoop party!

title: Survival Island
description:
Survival Island is an exciting survival simulator set on a tropical island!
Explore the island, gather resources, collect wood and stone, build shelters, and upgrade your character. Your survival depends entirely on your skills!

Craft tools, unlock new opportunities, expand your territory, and turn the wild island into your own base. But be careful — resources are limited, and you must constantly improve to survive.

Game Features:

* Resource gathering
* Building and crafting
* Character upgrades
* Island exploration
* Survival adventure atmosphere
* Simple and fun controls

Can you survive on the island and build your own paradise?

title: Clawler Fight
description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling blend of addictive gameplay of Clawler fight! In this action-packed game, you step into the shoes of an ordinary guy on a mission to survive the zombie apocalypse while tackling challenging levels. Maneuver a crane equipped with a claw to pick up objects and launch them at zombies! As you advance, you will collect valuable resources and currency, unlocking powerful upgrades for your character through a card-based skill progression system.

Prepare for fierce battles against a variety of terrifying zombies, each possessing unique abilities and strengths. Your ultimate objective is to survive.

Are you ready to face the ultimate challenge of skill and strategy? Gather your courage, sharpen your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable adventure in this ARPG masterpiece!

title: Sprunki Adventure 4
description:
🎮 Welcome to the frozen world of "Sprunki Adventure 4"! ❄️🏔️

A real disaster has struck the world of Sprunki — the huge Central Heater suddenly broke down, and a harsh winter quickly covered all the lands!

🧩 Begin a new adventure with Sprunki!
🔧 Search for lost parts to repair the Heater
👥 Help characters and complete winter quests

Your main goal is to collect all the necessary parts and help repair the Great Heater before the world completely freezes.

Can you bring warmth back to the world of Sprunki? 🔥

title: Rocketcar Cup
description: Rocketcar Cup is a fast-paced 2D arcade soccer game where rocket-powered cars battle for victory. Boost, jump, flip, and master aerial moves to score incredible goals in exciting one-on-one or team matches. Use skill, timing, and strategy to outplay your opponents, defend your goal, and become the ultimate champion. Easy to learn, challenging to master, and packed with non-stop action for players of all ages.

title: Knife Slice 3D
description:
Flip, slice, and conquer your way through exciting obstacle-filled levels in Knife Slice 3D! Master realistic knife physics as you jump between platforms, slice through stacks of objects, collect apples, and avoid deadly traps. Time every flip perfectly to reach the portal and complete increasingly challenging levels.

Explore colorful low-poly worlds filled with forests, castles, and unique environments while unlocking powerful new knives. Easy one-tap controls make the game simple to pick up, but only the most skilled players can master every level and achieve perfect landings.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing casual game or a fast-paced precision challenge, Knife Slice 3D delivers satisfying gameplay that's perfect for both desktop and mobile browsers.

Features
🔪 Addictive one-tap knife flipping gameplay
🍎 Slice objects and collect apples
⚠️ Dodge spinning saws, spikes, and challenging obstacles
🌲 Beautiful low-poly 3D environments
🎯 Smooth physics-based controls
🏰 Unlock new knives and explore unique worlds
📱 Optimized for mobile, desktop, and browser
🆓 Free to play with no downloads required

CREDITS & ATTRIBUTIONS: • 3D Models: "Low Poly Knife Collection" by BUttERflY_Bee (CC-BY 4.0 via Sketchfab) • UI & Icons: Flaticon, Mimu Studio, EmojiOne • Sound Effects: lloydevans09, gameaudio, mlaudio (via Freesound) & Pixabay Audio • Fonts & Code: Baloo, Liberation Sans, Kino Bloom, Preview Field, Cartoon FX

title: Barrel Roller: Stack & Run 3D
description:
🎮 Barrel Roller - The Ultimate Stack Runner Game! 🎮

Play the most addictive hyper casual runner game now! Stack barrels, dodge obstacles, and race to victory in this exciting endless runner adventure.

🏃 HOW TO PLAY THE STACK RUNNER:
- Swipe left and right to control your runner
- Collect and stack barrels as you race
- Avoid obstacles and traps along the track
- Build the tallest barrel stack possible
- Reach the finish line to win rewards!

✨ AMAZING RUNNER FEATURES:
- Hyper Casual Gameplay - Perfect for quick gaming sessions
- Easy Controls - Simple swipe mechanics for all ages
- Stack Mechanics - Collect and balance barrels while running
- Obstacle Course - Navigate through challenging levels
- Runner Game Fun - Non-stop action and excitement
- 3D Graphics - Smooth, colorful, and vibrant visuals
- Instant Play - No download required, play right in your browser
- Free to Play - Completely free
- Regular Updates - New levels and features added constantly

🏆 BECOME THE BARREL STACKING CHAMPION:
Master the art of stacking in this casual runner game! Challenge yourself to collect more barrels, avoid every obstacle, and achieve the highest score. Perfect for fans of running games, stacking games, and obstacle games.

📦 ADDICTIVE RUNNER GAMEPLAY:
Barrel Roller combines the best of endless runner games with unique stacking mechanics. Easy to learn but hard to master - can you become the ultimate barrel runner?

🎯 PERFECT FOR:
- Fans of hyper casual games
- Running game enthusiasts
- Stacking game lovers
- Obstacle course challenges
- Quick entertainment on the go

🌟 WHY PLAYERS LOVE BARREL ROLLER:
- "Best stacking runner game!"
- "So addictive and fun!"
- "Can't stop playing this amazing runner!"

Stack the barrels. Dodge the obstacles. Win the race!

title: Ultimate Obby Parkour Adventure Online
description: Join the thrilling adventure of Ultimate Obby Parkour, a colorful world filled with obstacles and unique challenges across four different realms. Enjoy engaging gameplay and vibrant graphics on both your phone and computer, as you customize your character and strive to become a parkour master.

title: Laser Slasher
description: Laser Slasher is a vibrant casual puzzle-arcade game where you command laser turrets to smash blocks with satisfying ASMR effects. Designed for stress-free relaxation, it combines intuitive one-tap controls, progressive upgrades, turret customization. Perfect for quick breaks or extended play.

title: Drift Idle Drift Earn Upgrade
description: Drift Idle is a chill arcade drift game where your car drives itself — you just lean into the corners. Slide sideways to rack up combos up to 10× and turn drift into a money printer, then sink the cash into three upgrade lanes: Income, Speed, and Drift. Earn enough and you'll trade your starter for sleeker rides — Boss, Blacklist, Fallout, Cairo, and the elusive Midnight — each one drifting harder and paying out fatter than the last. Customise your paint, your smoke colour, and your skid trails until the track behind you looks exactly the way you want.

title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
description:
Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Easy-to-play and addictive !

title: Brainrot Hide and Seek Classic
description:
Everyone has played hide-and-seek at least once. With each level, changing locations will keep you busy.

In the game, you have to move quickly and skillfully before you get caught. Each level becomes more difficult, requiring you to have faster reaction speed, agility, and the ability to plan your movements.

title: Spin and Collect
description:
Spin & Collect is the ultimate collecting game! Every spin awards coins, gems, and rare items. Complete sets to unlock powerful bonuses, win jackpots, and watch your collection grow even offline with AFK rewards. From Common to Legendary, will you be able to collect them all? Optional rewarded ads accelerate your progress without interrupting the game. Perfect for casual players and those looking to complete everything!

Double Wheels: Basic Wheel for constant progression + Premium Wheel for colossal jackpots
Epic Collections: Unlock items from Common to Legendary rarity
Set Bonuses: Complete collections to get permanent bonuses and multipliers
AFK Rewards: Keep earning coins even offline; progress is constant!
Mobile Optimized: Smooth one-tap gameplay, ideal for quick sessions on the go

title: Mergetopia
description: 🌍 Mergetopia A delightful 2D casual merge game where evolution happens one merge at a time! 🐾 Dive into a Realm each filled with popular sea animals characters waiting to be discovered, merged, and evolved. Your goal? Build and discover the Creatures — one bubble pop and one merge at a time!

title: Idle Pong
description: Idle Pong is a fun and satisfying idle clicker game where every tap launches a high-speed pong ball to smash through colorful obstacles! Watch the chaos unfold as your pong bounces, breaks, and earns you XP even while you're idle.

title: Build a Go-Kart
description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.

🏁 Race & Earn
Drive your own tracks, earn income for every segment, and refine your strategy.

🧱 Flexible Building
Straights, turns, boosters, and dangerous sections — build a track that works for you.

💰 Economy & Progression
Earn currencies, unlock new blocks and skins, and expand your building area.

🔁 Prestige System
Reset your progress to grow faster and unlock new opportunities.

🎁 Daily Rewards
Come back every day and claim bonuses to boost your progress.

Build, test, and optimize your tracks — and turn every race into profit.
Can you create the perfect track?

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?

A: It's an arcade game where players need to create their own track by placing various blocks.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it engage players?

A: The game is about Obby. Players can race on their kart on the track, earn money for each segment, and use the earnings to unlock new blocks, expand their territory, and improve the track for even greater profits.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Racing on the track, earning money for each segment, using the money to unlock new blocks for greater profits, expand their territory, and improve the track.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: In the game, there are diamonds and money as currencies. Both currencies can be spent on purchasing new blocks and skins.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. Players can buy diamonds, which are then used to purchase blocks. Donations speed up game progress.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: In the game, there are Obby and skins for Obby.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?

A: Yes, the game offers daily rewards and rewards for time spent in the game.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game but is not necessary for gameplay.

title: TCG Shop: Maps, Toys and Comics
description:
Open your own store in the new trading simulator! Sell TCG cards, figures, comics, food, collectibles, toys - everything geeks and fans love. Serve customers, restock shelves, manage the cash register, deliver orders and expand your business. Upgrade your store, unlock new items, hire employees and build a shopping empire!

This game about store combines elements of simulator, clicker and business game, will suit fans of economic strategies, management and TCG-cards. Simple controls, bright graphics and the excitement of business development make the game exciting and accessible to everyone.

Try to become the best merchant and expand your store to the level of the legendary marketplace! Play online for free right in your browser. Perfect for fans of store simulators, card games, shipping and business pumping.

title: TCG Shop: Maps, Toys and Comics
description:
Open your own store in the new trading simulator! Sell TCG cards, figures, comics, food, collectibles, toys - everything geeks and fans love. Serve customers, restock shelves, manage the cash register, deliver orders and expand your business. Upgrade your store, unlock new items, hire employees and build a shopping empire!

This game about store combines elements of simulator, clicker and business game, will suit fans of economic strategies, management and TCG-cards. Simple controls, bright graphics and the excitement of business development make the game exciting and accessible to everyone.

Try to become the best merchant and expand your store to the level of the legendary marketplace! Play online for free right in your browser. Perfect for fans of store simulators, card games, shipping and business pumping.

title: Sky Ball  - Adventure 3D
description:
Roll, jump & rush through sky tracks! Avoid obstacles and beat the challenge.

Get ready for an epic rolling adventure in Sky Ball 3D: Rush & Roll — a fast, thrilling sky-platform game where speed and precision decide everything!

Control a powerful 3D ball as you race through floating sky tracks, avoid obstacles, jump across gaps, and rush to the finish. Each level becomes tougher with moving platforms, traps, sharp turns, and surprise speed boosters.

Collect coins, unlock new ball skins, and challenge your reflexes in the ultimate sky racing experience — perfect for players of all ages!

🎮 Game Features

🌌 Beautiful sky-themed 3D levels

🏐 Smooth rolling, jumping & control mechanics

💎 Collect coins to unlock new balls & skins

⚡ Fast-paced gameplay with exciting obstacles

🔧 Supports Fire TV Remote & Game Controllers

📶 Fully offline — play anytime, anywhere

🌀 Addictive level progression with increasing difficulty

If you enjoy ball rush games, rolling games, or fast reflex challenges, Sky Ball 3D delivers the perfect combination of speed & fun.
Download now and start rolling through the clouds!

title: Street Racer 2D
description: Street Racer 2 is a driving drag-racing game where your goal is to win races, upgrade, and buy new cars. This game offers an exhilarating mix of play modes, including drag racing, off-road challenges, and arcade-style fun. Each mode delivers a distinct experience, whether chasing high-speed thrills, conquering rugged terrain, or enjoying adrenaline-packed track action.

title: Star Wing
description: Earth's last hope is in your hands, take control of the lone spaceship and protect Earth from alien swarms. Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies. In this space shooting game, you will be facing an increasingly large number of enemies in hazardous environments. As the game progresses, you will earn the right to upgrade your spacecraft to unleash its full lethal capacity.

title: Rolling Balls 3D
description: Rolling Balls 3D is a casual game in which you have to test your reaction and dexterity. The goal of the game is to guide the ball through an endless maze of obstacles, collecting balls along the way to get more! The bottom line is that every time you collect a ball, a clone of your ball is created and added to the maze, increasing the difficulty as you progress!

title: Basketball Tap
description:
Basketball Tap is a fast-paced casual sports game.
Time your taps perfectly, launch the ball into the air, and score epic slam dunks!

title: Eternal Dance
description: Eternal Dance is a calm, meditative arcade game about keeping balance. Two koi — one black, one white — endlessly circle a glowing orb in a hand-painted zen pond. Drifting ink threatens the orb from the dark, and only the koi of the matching color can dissolve it. Guide their dance, protect the orb, and lose yourself in the flow. Easy to learn, hard to master — a one-touch game that trades frantic reflexes for focus and serenity.

title: Click Kitty Idle
description:
Click Kitty Idle– Fast-Paced Cat Clicker Challenge!
Click Kitty Idle is a fun and competitive idle clicker game where speed, timing, and strategy matter! Tap to feed your kitty, level up, and dominate the leaderboard in this addictively cute cat-clicking game!                                             
Why You’ll Love It:
If you enjoy fast-paced clicker games with a twist, It’s not just about clicking—it's about clicking smart and fast.
Play now and prove you’ve got the fastest paws in town!

•Cute & competitive gameplay with pressure-based challenges!
•Buy fun food like tuna, milk, cheese & more!
•Unlock cute cat characters like Miss Pawlina and Captain Purrbeard!
•Boosters: Auto Click, Time Extension, and Massive Click Power!
•Compete for high scores and unlock achievements!

title: Arkanoid For Painters
description: Arkanoid For Painters is a thrilling online game where players create barriers to control a ball, clearing blocks and foes. It blends classic gameplay with artistic elements, catering to creative strategists. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it guarantees entertaining challenges on the go.

title: 2048 3D: Merge Cubes
description:
Merge the Blocks, Reach 2048, and Conquer the Levels!**

Blocks with numbers from 2 to 2048 drop onto the field. Combine matching blocks to create higher-value ones and score points. But watch out — some blocks are stones, which can’t be merged. Use powerful boosters like bombs and lightning to clear them out.
1. Make the most of your boosters:
2. X2 — doubles the value of any number block
3. Bomb — destroys surrounding blocks

Flash — removes all stones from the field

Don’t let the blocks stack above the top boundary for more than three seconds — or it’s game over!

Complete challenging levels, set high scores in endless mode, and become the ultimate merge master!

title: Precision Parking Pro
description:
Precision Parking Pro is the ultimate test of control, timing, and skill. Step into the driver’s seat and prove you’ve got what it takes to park with perfection. From tight city alleys to complex multi-level garages, every challenge pushes your precision and patience to the limit.

Master realistic vehicle physics, responsive steering, and smooth camera controls as you navigate tricky obstacles, narrow turns, and dynamic environments. Earn rewards, unlock new cars, and climb the ranks from rookie driver to true parking professional.

title: Air Warfare
description: Fly into excitement with **Air Warfare**, an endless game where you take charge of a combat plane. Shoot down foes, gather ammo, avoid attacks, and strive for survival. Compete for high scores while enjoying smooth gameplay on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Car And Truck Parking Game
description: Welcome to the world of car and truck parking games. Get ready to experience the best of both worlds with a car and truck parking game. Realistic and addictive parking simulator where you can test your skills driving both cars and massive trucks. This game brings you a full driving experience in one powerful package. Precision, patience, and control are the keys to success. Park your vehicle perfectly, avoid obstacles, and complete dozens of increasingly difficult levels.

title: Tornado-67
description:
Become the hungriest tornado in the world!

Start your journey as a small whirlwind capable of absorbing only tiny objects, and gradually grow into a massive destructive force of nature.

Explore 3 unique locations: a sunny beach, a bustling city, and a suburban neighborhood. Absorb everything in your path — from flip-flops and beach umbrellas to cars and entire buildings.

The more objects you collect, the stronger your tornado becomes, allowing you to absorb even larger and heavier objects.

Destroy, grow, and unleash a true tornado apocalypse!

title: Super Fruit Runner - Hyper Casual
description:
In this hyper casual runner game 🚀, you control fast-moving fruits and dodge obstacles to reach the finish line 🍏. With 15 unique levels 🗺️ and 12 special achievements 🎖️, the fun never ends! Thanks to 7 language options — English 🇬🇧, Russian 🇷🇺, French 🇫🇷, Turkish 🇹🇷, Spanish 🇪🇸, German 🇩🇪, and Italian 🇮🇹 — everyone can enjoy the game 🌍.

Destroy fruits by hitting knives 🗡️ and earn Yakut to buy powerful upgrades 💎, including:

Increase starting fruit count 🍎

Increase Yakut earnings 💰

Extra reward for hitting green platforms ➕

Reduce loss from hitting red platforms ➖

Use your speed, reflexes, and strategy 🧠💨 to clear all levels, unlock every achievement 🎖️.

title: Sky Blocks Falling
description:
Sky Blocks Falling is an idle Arkanoid-style game where you catch falling blocks to fill platforms and earn money.

Features
Upgrade your speed for faster block-catching
Add more platforms to increase your capacity
Unlock critical hits for bonus rewards
Boost your income with progressive upgrades
Prestige to accelerate future progress
Complete a variety of achievements
Customize your experience with block skins and atmospheric themes
Can you build the ultimate sky-falling machine?

title: Build Obby World
description:
🌈 Welcome to Build Obby World!

Jump, build, explore, and create your own magical world full of surprises, pets, and treasures! 🎁🐾✨

Start with a tiny island… gather resources, then build pieces of other islands to reach new places! 🌟

Tap tiny slimes to bring this world to life!

Upgrade and upgrade your character's tools!

Make your island big, colorful, and happy! 🌈✨

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: It's a game where you gather resources, craft, build, explore, and create your own magical world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? How can it hook players?
A: High-quality graphics, many skins, an exciting obby adventure, survival gameplay, resource gathering, and cute slimes and pets.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Trendy skins featuring Italian brainrots.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does progression work? What do players need to do to level up faster?
A: The obby opens new ports and locations through building and construction.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (e.g., common - gold, premium - crystals)?
A: The game has two currencies: gold and crystals. They can be spent on necessary in-game materials, such as an axe or an improved pickaxe for resource gathering.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what effect does it have? Does donating accelerate game progress?
A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy skins and crystals. Crystals can later be exchanged for gold to buy new, improved tools for faster resource gathering.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can players customize the hero's appearance, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can buy different skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: Music enhances the game but is not necessary for completing the levels or progression.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are the achievements and how are they earned?
A: The game features a collection of slimes and pets.

title: Stickman Jump
description: Stickman Jump is a fast-paced platformer in which you have to jump and run across platforms with a little stickman. You control a small character who sprints at full speed and needs precise timing to jump over obstacles and complete each level. The further you get, the greater the challenges that will test your reflexes and concentration.

title: Knife Smash
description: Do you like throwing stuff? Like knives at random spinning targets? Then this is the ultimate challenge for you! Time your actions, aim carefully and become the knife master! Can you beat all the levels? Very simple one-touch gameplay, but challenging to master! Can you collect all the ridiculous knives?

title: Team Loyalty
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Team Loyalty, where you command a growing army. Start with one unit and strategically pass through gates to boost your numbers. Overcome challenges and dominate your foes with strength in numbers. Are you ready to build the ultimate team to triumph?

title: Streamer Simulator: Phone Challenge!
description: «Streamer Simulator: Phone Challenge!» – a thrilling arcade experience! Perform kick-flips, spin your phone 360°, and chain insane combos to wow your audience. Follow the live chat and see your fans react in real-time! Rack up likes to unlock new phones, from vintage bricks to the latest foldables. Master your reflexes, agility, and rhythm. Battle your friends and claim the crown as the ultimate hype master!

title: Obby: Save the Brainrots Online
description:
Obby: Save the Brainrots Online is a dynamic reaction arcade game where a huge wave is already on its way, and you only have seconds to make it!
Grab the brainrots, take them away from the advancing elements and deliver them to a safe zone. The faster you act, the more likely you are to find and save the rarest meme characters.
Boost your speed to be able to carry the rescued out of the affected area before the water covers everything around.
Look for Brainrots of varying rarity, from common to legendary. Replenish your collection, unlock new bonuses and feel your progress growing.
And most importantly, the game has online multiplayer: come in with your friends, rescue brainrots with a team, or compete to see who brings the most valuable finds before the wave arrives.
Are you ready to test your reaction and speed? Run, grab and save — the tsunami is not waiting!

title: Bunny Escape
description: In Bunny Escape you play as a bunny that gets trapped in different situations. The game works with just one button. Escape from those situations by running, attacking and jumping across the different worlds.

title: Obby Upgrade Your Speed!
description:
Want to become super fast? ⚡
In Obby Upgrade Your Speed you power up by tapping: tap → earn Run Points → run faster!

🚀 More points = more speed.
🐾 Unlock pets to boost progress and strengthen taps: you get 2 or 3 points per tap depending on your pet.
🏁 Hit crazy speed, beat your records, and feel the rush!

title: Slime Clicker
description:
Get ready to click your way to ultimate slime glory in Slime Clicker, the most relaxing and fun idle clicker on the web! ✨

Tap, click, and chill as you rack up points by booping your adorable slime. Every click brings you closer to new levels, shiny upgrades, and delightfully cute skins — from Bat Slime to Rabbit Slime, each evolution is lovelier and more rewarding than the last.

Don’t blink! Every so often, a Mini Slime appears — and catching it in time gives you a juicy bonus to your total points. Combine lucky clicks with powerful passive upgrades like AutoClickers, and watch your slime empire grow even when you’re not playing.

Simple, satisfying, and absurdly cute, Slime Clicker is the perfect game to unwind, laugh, and click your heart out. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, there’s always another slime waiting to make your day brighter.

title: Cat Escape: Hide and Seek
Feeding A Black Hole
description:
A  Game About Feeding A Black Hole! 🕳️

Devour asteroids 🪨

Grow steadily 📈

And become unstoppable 💫

A  game about feeding a Black Hole 🪐🌀

What awaits you:
🌱 Deep progression & expansive skill tree
🎁 Choose 1 of 3 random rewards after each level
🔄 Prestige system with permanent progress multipliers

title: Bottle Bottle
description:
Bottle Bottle is a casual jumping game that is easy to play but challenging to master.

In the game, you control a bottle and help it jump from one platform to another. With simple tap controls, the bottle flips and jumps forward. Perfect timing and rhythm are the key to landing safely and going further.

Clean visuals and smooth animations make the gameplay relaxing and fun. Try again and again to beat your best distance!

title: Mom I Can Fly
description: A fun flying game. Your goal is simply flying a kid to the highlighted area. Progress level to level through various fun obstacles and challenges.

title: Stack Master
description:
Stack master is a minimalistic, endless stacking game where your goal is to build the tower as high as possible by perfectly aligning moving blocks.
The graphics are simple and clean, focusing on smooth gameplay without distractions.
You compete globally for the highest score (tower height) on leaderboards.

title: Team Men
description: Gather teammates of the same color on the roads and gather a larger army. Reach the finish line at the end of the road, build the best army you can, collect the highest score and strengthen your army with points.

title: Void Shot
description: Void Shot is a one-hand neon arcade shooter set in the glowing depths of space. Slide your turret along the bottom of the screen — it fires on its own — and pop endless waves of pulsing rings before they reach you. Every fifth wave ends in a boss fight, and each boss plays differently: some teleport, some split, some spawn minions. Random wave modifiers — crosswind, low gravity, turbo drift, extra bounce — reshuffle the rules so no two runs feel the same. Catch power-ups (frost, double damage, rapid fire, shield), bank coins and permanently upgrade your turret between runs. How deep into the void can you go?

title: Lane Clash
description: Lane Hold is a casual 3D lane-defense game. Hold your fortress across five parallel lanes: tap a lane shield to spawn warriors, clash power head-on, and stop enemies before they breach the wall. Clear short waves, upgrade lanes and the base between rounds, and use Shield, Bomb, and Freeze when the pressure rises — no joystick, no chasing camera, just tense lane battles.

title: Cut It All 3D
description:
The player will have to cut objects into pieces, following certain rules. The player needs to use his logical and spatial thought process to solve each task that is presented to him.

The game includes various difficulty levels, ranging from easy and simple to more complex and advanced levels that require a high level of skill. The player is given the opportunity to choose different types of objects that he will slice, and different ways of slicing, such as slicing, slicing in a line, etc.

title: Sprunki: Collect All Characters!
description:
Sprunki: Collect All Characters! — a dynamic platformer where dangerous levels, skillful jumps, and the hunt for rare heroes await you! Complete challenging stages, collect items, and unlock more and more characters from the world of Sprunki. Can you become number one in the rankings? 🔥

🏃‍♂️ What awaits you:
• Exciting platformer gameplay — run, jump, and survive on dangerous levels ⚡
• Moving platforms and traps — test your reaction and skills 😈
• Ropes, gaps, and obstacles — every level brings a new challenge 🎭
• Character collection — unlock unique heroes from the Sprunki world ✨
• Tough moments — only the most skilled will reach the end 💪
• Player rankings — compete with others and become the best 🏆
• Fun boosters — move faster, jump higher, and play even cooler 🚀

Collect all characters, overcome every challenge, and prove that you are the true hero of the Sprunki world! 👑
[Core Gameplay & Story\]
Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is a 2D platformer where you jump across various platforms to find and collect all the Sprunkis for your collection. You must navigate obstacles and plan your moves to reach specific platforms and collect special items. Each item belongs to a specific Sprunki; you need to collect 10 items of the same type to find and unlock that Sprunki for your collection.

Q: What is the game's standout feature and why will it appeal to players?
A: The game features high-quality polish, beautiful graphics, and a wide variety of features that keep the gameplay feeling fresh and diverse.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: The Sprunkis themselves are the main draw.

\[Economy & Customization\]
Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game? Does spending money speed up progress?
A: Yes, you can purchase an ad-free experience as well as unlimited boosts, such as the magnet, double jump, and increased movement speed.

\[Retention & Engagement\]
Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are available?
A: Yes, there are leaderboards. Your score and ranking are determined by how many Sprunki unlock items you have collected.

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: There are rewards granted for every 5 minutes of play that refresh when you restart the game. these consist of boosts like the magnet, double jump, and movement speed.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without it make the game difficult?
A: It is not required, but the sound design is high quality and enhances the experience.

title: Grand Truck Simulator
description:
Get behind the wheel of powerful trucks in this realistic grand truck simulator! Your mission is simple yet challenging — drive to the location of a broken-down car, load it onto your flatbed trailer, and transport it safely to the repair shop. Navigate busy roads, sharp turns, and unexpected obstacles on your route. Precision matters — secure the vehicle properly before hitting the highway!

Unlock and choose from a variety of trucks, each with unique handling and performance. Complete delivery jobs, earn rewards, and upgrade your fleet to become the ultimate roadside hero.

Feel the thrill of heavy vehicle transport, test your driving skills, and prove you’re the best recovery truck driver in town! Ready to tow, haul, and deliver? Start the engine and roll out!

title: Dungeon Descent
description: Loot. Survive. Descend deeper. A fast voxel dungeon crawler with deadly rooms, powerful gear, and bosses waiting below.

title: 3D Pool Mania
description: Pool Mania is an exciting single-player billiards game with smooth controls, realistic physics, and engaging gameplay. Test your skills across various challenges, master trick shots, and enjoy a relaxing yet competitive experience with immersive visuals and customizable options.

title: Chainsaw 3D
description: Chainsaw 3D is an exciting online arcade game where you cut logs using a chainsaw. Available for free on multiple platforms, this engaging woodcutting challenge blends skill and puzzle elements, requiring concentration to succeed at each new level. Aim to become the top woodcutter!

title: Orbit Shift
description:
You're locked in orbit around a dying star: two rings, two lanes, one chance. Tap to switch. Don't get hit. How long can you last?

Orbit Shift is a one-tap lane-switching endless space arcade game where reflexes are everything. Comets, shooting stars, and meteors spawn at the top of two concentric rings and spiral clockwise toward your ship. Your only move is shifting between the inner and outer ring — but timing that one move perfectly, over and over, faster and faster, is everything.

Each stage runs exactly one minute and escalates in speed and obstacle density, climaxing in a surge — a short, intense burst of rapid-fire obstacles that acts as a skill gate before the next stage unlocks. Difficulty pulses in waves: pressure builds to each surge, then briefly eases, before the next stage raises the floor. By Stage 5, gaps between hazards shrink to fractions of a second.

Survival time is your score, tracked against your personal best. No checkpoints. Every run starts from zero. You'll have to earn every second.

Cosmetics — trails, ships, and color schemes — unlock through achievements tied to real gameplay stats. All purely visual. No pay-to-win, no randomness. Play anywhere — no download required, instant play on desktop and mobile.

Orbit Shift is an original game handcrafted by cfc, a human game developer.

title: Cars Challenge
description:
Welcome to the game about cars, in which you can play in different modes compete with bots, perform tasks and tuning your new cars!

Modes in the game:

- Arena:
Clash with other cars and survive in the arena!

- Spinning Wheel:
The obstacle wheel is spinning, your task is to get to the finish line faster than other cars and not fall into the abyss!


- Hexagons:
Hexagons fall down as soon as a car passes over them.
Show your dexterity in steering and jumping to stay last in the arena and win.

- Insane Track:
On the crazy track you will have to go through a bunch of challenges and obstacles to get to the end of the crazy track faster than the other cars and win!

And much more!

title: Go Up
description:
Welcome to Go Up, the exciting free mobile game that challenges you to protect the balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this amazing balloon game that'll keep you on your toes and your eyes glued to the screen.

Picture this. You have a tiny balloon you need to protect. You need to push away all the pointy and heavy things that get in the way of your balloon going up. But it's not that easy. The sky is full of all kinds of strange things like blocks, beams, and triangles. If your balloon even touches one of these, it's all over. Exciting, right?

But it gets even better! The higher your balloon goes, the harder the game gets. The obstacles become trickier and more difficult to avoid. You can push everything out of the way, but watch out! If you send blocks flying everywhere, you will find it difficult to protect the balloon.

title: Soccer Strike
description: Experience casual soccer at its finest with intuitive pull-back and strike controls. Form your striking lineup, aim for the goal, and enjoy Soccer Strike—the perfect mix of fun and competitive play in an instant game tribute to the world's favorite sport.

title: Only Up Parkour 2
description: Only Up Parkour 2! is an exciting arcade game in which you have to overcome obstacles and conquer heights of 500M. Inspired by the popular game Your task is to guide the character through a vertical labyrinth full of various obstacles. You must react quickly, jump accurately and climb up dexterously to avoid crashing into obstacles and falling down. As you progress through the various levels, you will encounter increasing difficulty and new challenges such as Jumping platforms and obstacles.

title: Bubble Gum
description:
Blow it up and rise high! 🎈✨

Welcome to an exciting arcade game where lightness is your secret weapon!
Inflate balloons, dodge obstacles, and climb as high as you can! The bigger your balloon, the more coins you earn - but watch out for spikes!

How big can you grow your balloon?

title: Doodle Boba Bubble Tea.
description:
Tangy and fruity or sweet and milky? The combinations are endless!
Honeydew, matcha, raspberry, mocha – no matter the flavour, don’t forget to mix in some bubbly balls made with fruit jelly or tapioca.

Satisfy your craving and make a yummy cup of Boba Bubble Tea.

title: JUMPER
description:
JUMPER

Прыгай к новым высотам побивая  Рекорды, подбирая Уникальные бонусы и уворачиваясь от  Эпичных ловушек  с  
Улучшенной графикой!🌟

Коллекционируй  очаровательные Скины👔,  получая Достижения🏆

title: Slasty: Candy Tower
description:
Meet “Slasty: Candy Tower” - a breathtaking action-arcade where cute hungry monsters sit on the crazy-spinning platforms, and you shoot them with a candy gun to feed them up! Try to make your candy-shots precise to achieve unbelievable combos, set records and compete with other players to become the best! Feed a monster simply by tapping on the screen at the right time to make a candy shot. Complete tower-levels with various platforms, but beware, they are spinning faster and faster! Open new levels with new towers. Each tower has different mechanics, style, and platforms.
Game works without internet, just download and play wherever you want.
Play at any time, in any place, your progress will not be lost.

Features:
- Control the Hero on the tower and shoot monsters with candies
- Dive into awesome toon environment
- Make accurate shots, combos and set high scores
- Don’t rush but be precise to win
- Feel the challenge of the game
- Compete with players around the world and set the highest score
- Simple one-touch controls
- Plain and clear UI

title: Keepie Uppie Paddle Pong
description:
Bounce the ball, collect coins, and unlock achievements.
- Every hit = coins.
- The more you bounce — the closer your next achievement.
- Decorate your paddle with your favorite character and show your style.
- Catch the vibe, laugh and complete the collection!

title: Fluffy Jump
description:
The objective is to jump from platform to platform while continuously moving forward. Missing any platform results in failure, and the player’s speed gradually increases as the game progresses. The challenge lies in surviving as long as possible to achieve the highest time-based score.
Key Features:
Simple controls: Intuitive and quick controls.
Dynamic difficulty increase: The game becomes more challenging as you progress.

title: Farmers vs. Aliens
description: Lead the animals to their enclosures, identified by green arrows and matching images. Keep them inside the green zone to prevent alien abductions! As the game progresses, it slows down at a certain point. If you don't gather the animals in time, aliens will arrive to take them. Leaving the green zone—whether it's you or the animals—will trigger a UFO to appear and abduct them. If aliens take more than two animals or capture you, it's game over. Stay fast and remain in the green zone to survive!

title: Tilt & Tumble
description: Tilt & Tumble challenges players to master fast-paced action without needing extensive tutorials. Control the game using joystick or accelerometer to guide the paddle with precision, keeping the ball in play and scoring points. Enjoy dynamic music, unlock various paddles. Tilt & Tumble delivers an exhilarating gaming experience that keeps you coming back for more.

title: Stick Master Teleport
description:
Jump onto walls, throw knives, and teleport to your enemies ⚔️ to defeat them with a single strike 💥.
Prove your ninja reputation by eliminating bad guys before they even notice 😈.
Walk the tough path of a ninja to become a true ninja assassin!

💪 🎮 “Stick Master Teleport” is one of the most exciting ninja games featuring stealth puzzles 🧩 and teleportation gameplay! ⚡ ⚔️

💠 USE DEADLY WEAPONS
There are many types of deadly gear 💣 to defeat your enemies.
In this thrilling ninja game, you can choose traditional ninja weapons such as:
🔪 knife, 🗡️ sword, 🌀 boomerang, and 🪓 club. Adapt your arsenal for every mission! 🎯

💠 Why you’ll love this ninja game:
⚡ Exciting gameplay
🧩 Challenging ninja puzzles
🗺️ Many tricky levels
🌀 Unique combat mechanics
Play “Stick Master Teleport” now ⚡ and strike down cunning enemies in a flash! 💥🔥

title: Roll King
description: You steer a sticky ball through colorful voxel worlds — city streets, picnic spreads, deserts, pastry kitchens, and outer space. Roll into toys, food, furniture, and whatever else is smaller than you; everything you touch sticks and makes you bigger. Hit your size goals, chase stars, and keep rolling through 50 stages (then endless mode). Use power-ups like magnets, freezes, and size boosts when you need a push — and don’t let the timer catch you.

title: Telekinetic Pumpkin
description:
Telekinetic Pumpkin is an arcade game where an experiment aimed at creating a magnificent, oversized pumpkin for Halloween takes an unexpected turn, resulting in the creation of a telekinetic pumpkin.


You’re a Pumpkin that teleports and moves objects with its mind! Destroy drones by smashing them, and collect power-ups to stay alive. Select your upgrades and try to survive as long as possible.

title: StickerBall
description:
Stickerball is a fast-paced game where you collect stickers using a ball with unique abilities! Your goal is to collect 180 colorful stickers across 9 levels by completing challenges and activating triggers that change the game’s rules. Each turn, 10 stickers fly onto the field from a purchased pack, but any uncollected ones disappear—act quickly and precisely!

The game shines with 14 dynamic triggers: freeze stickers, double rewards with "x2," turn the ball into a magnet or ghost, activate "disco" mode, or control a dual ball! The more stickers you collect in one turn, the higher your combo and the more coins you earn. Holo-stickers, with their unique designs, grant double the currency!

Play across 12 vibrant, randomly changing fields. Buy sticker packs, upgrade your collection, and strategize by activating triggers at the perfect moment to maximize rewards.

title: Pop It 3D
description: Players take turns pressing down any number of bubbles in a single row and consecutively. The player who presses the last bubble loses the game.

title: Bouncy Ball
description:
Bouncy Ball is a fun and addictive arcade platformer where timing is everything ⚡️
Guide a happy bouncing ball across floating platforms, avoid deadly spikes, and survive tricky jumps that get harder every level 😱

Each bounce matters 🟠✨
Tap at the right moment to control the ball’s movement, master precision jumps, and keep your ball alive as long as possible. Simple controls, smooth animations, and vibrant neon visuals make every run exciting and satisfying 🎨🔥

Can you keep bouncing and beat your high score? 🚀🏆

title: King of Fishing
description:
Dive into the thrilling underwater world of King of Fishing! Take control of powerful fishing cannons in a fast-paced top-down arcade experience where timing, aim, and strategy are the keys to victory. Shoot nets to catch colorful fish, rare sea creatures, and massive ocean bosses while collecting coins and special rewards.

Upgrade your gear, unlock stronger cannons, and explore vibrant ocean zones filled with unique species and dynamic challenges. The bigger and rarer the fish you catch, the greater the rewards. Test your reflexes, dominate the seas, and become the true King of Fishing!

title: Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars!
description:
Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars — your epic adventure starts now! 🎈 Rescue the balloon from sneaky traps and become its fearless hero 🛡️! Control the speedy defender, smash obstacles, and catch stars ⭐ to soar to the top!  

What’s waiting for you:  

- Tons of fun and thrilling challenges  
- Super-awesome powers 💥  
- Bright skins for the balloon and defender 🎨  
- Non-stop adventure 🔁

Conquer the skies, unlock cool looks, and prove you’re the ultimate champ! 😎

title: Epic Mine Idle
description:
⛏️ Dig at full speed! Break rocks and extract rare resources. But don't let your guard down: keep an eye on your health (HP) to avoid being caught off guard by a cave-in.

🔥 Hot work! Use powerful drills for fast mining. But beware—the equipment can overheat! Optimize your timing and let your tools cool down to keep digging without stopping.

💎 Real treasures. From sparkling sapphires to pure gold—collect a collection of the rarest minerals. The deeper you mine, the more valuable your loot!

👷 Stylish hero. Your miner is a true professional in a fashionable blue suit. Who said mining can't be stylish?

⚡ Leveling and upgrades. Improve your equipment, increase your health, and reduce your drill's cooldown time. Become the most efficient miner in history!

title: Squishy Sheep
description:
Your mission is to help an adorable cat friend collect every balloon in each level. All it takes is removing the right platform at just the right moment and letting physics do the magic.

Every level is carefully designed to be solved with just a few clicks, while the sheep bounces across ledges and gathers balloons in delightful, unexpected ways. With fluid animations and a cute, inviting art style, Squishy Sheep keeps you coming back for more until every level is complete.

title: Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Sea Magic
description:
I, English:
**🎃 Magic Cat Academy 2 – Underwater Halloween Adventure**

In this fun and spooky *Halloween Doodle* game, you get to play as **Momo**, a brave magical cat who dives deep **under the sea** to protect ocean creatures and stop ghostly trouble! 🌊🐱👻 

After her school adventure in the first game, Momo returns to face a **new challenge** — this time in the ocean! Ghosts have followed her underwater and are hiding in all kinds of sea creatures. Your mission? **Draw magical shapes** to cast spells and send the ghosts away so everything can be peaceful again. 

**✨ What Makes It Exciting**

* You explore **deep sea zones** filled with spooky ghost-infested sea creatures like jellyfish and anglerfish.
* Each ghost shows a **shape above its head** — your job is to draw that shape quickly to cast a spell and defeat it.
* As you go deeper, the challenges get harder but more fun!

**🐾 Why Kids Love It**

* Bright, colorful underwater world 🌈
* Cool characters and cute ghosts 👻
* Easy swipe or mouse drawing to cast magic ✨
* Great for players who like something spellbinding and fun!

II, Russian:
🎃 Magic Cat Academy 2 – Подводное Хэллоуин-приключение

В этой весёлой и немного таинственной игре от Google на Хэллоуин вы играете за Момо — храброго волшебного котёнка, который отправляется в подводный мир, чтобы защитить морских жителей и остановить непослушных призраков! 🌊🐱👻

После событий первой игры Момо снова вступает в бой — только теперь под водой! Призраки спрятались в разных морских существах, и вам нужно помочь Момо прогнать их. Чтобы победить призраков, рисуйте простые фигурки на экране, и котёнок наложит заклинание, чтобы очистить море. ✨

✨ Что делает игру интересной

Вы исследуете глубины океана, где в морских обитателях прячутся призраки — медузы, рыбы-удильщики и другие.

Над каждым призраком появляется символ, и вам нужно быстро нарисовать его, чтобы победить врага.

Чем дальше вы играете, тем веселее и сложнее становится приключение!

🐾 Почему детям нравится эта игра

Красочный подводный мир 🌈

Забавные персонажи и милые призраки 👻

Простое управление — рисуй и побеждай ✨

Отлично подходит для тех, кто любит магию и приключения!

title: Chu Choo Cake
description: If you love cake, then you will want to help Chef Piggo to save his creations from the hungry mice! These mice are greedy, and they will stop at nothing to try and stop the chef. This game combines elements of both Pacman and Donkey Kong and has retro graphics too. Move the chef around the level and try to drop the cakes to the bottom by standing on them. You must save each cake before you can complete the level - make sure you avoid the greedy mice too though!

title: On Fire Basketball Shots
description:
The gym is packed, and the crowd is roaring! The scoreboard's ticking down, and your team is trailing. The only way to win is to sink blazing basketball shots from the court. You're the star player, but the pressure's on—every shot counts, and the hoop's rim is red-hot, making each attempt trickier!
"Core: A highly engaging, physics-based arcade sports simulator centered on precision shooting and high-score chasing.
Loop: Players engage in skill-based shooting mechanics to accumulate points, which convert into hard currency (coins) used for continuous progression and reward loops.
Start: Features instant, intuitive accessibility, ensuring immediate player engagement and a strong hook from the first session.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Utilizes a clean, contemporary Flat Design aesthetic that ensures visual clarity and broad appeal.
Key Feature: Offers deep player customization through various unlockable ball and environment skins, underpinned by robust, authentic shot physics."

title: Nexusorbiter
description:
Single-finger orbital-defense arcade. Your drone orbits a fragile space station and auto-fires at incoming hazards — tap
to flip the orbit direction, that's your only control. Each stage layers in new threats: glue bombs you must shoot at
range, homing suicide drones you can't miss, EMP drones that silence your auto-fire on contact, healing orbiters that
protect bosses. Six upgrade tracks shape your build. 30+ stages, multi-boss waves, plus a fresh daily challenge for
bonus scrap every day.

title: Precise Shooting
description: Test your aim and precision in Precise Shooting, a satisfying basketball shooting challenge! Launch the ball with perfect timing and angle to score into the hoop from various tricky positions and distances. The core idea is mastering trajectory and power — one well-timed shot can earn you massive points and combos. What makes it unique? Beautiful minimalist 3D visuals, realistic ball physics with satisfying arcs, increasing difficulty with moving hoops and obstacles, and the addictive “one more try” feeling as you chase perfect shots and high scores!

title: Rolling In Gears
description: Rolling In Gears is an engaging puzzle physics platformer game where you control a ball navigating through a series of mechanical challenges. The game’s main mechanic revolves around rotating gears and moving platforms to guide the ball towards its target destination. Players need to carefully maneuver through the levels, using precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end of each stage.

title: Cats Go!
description: Cats Go! - is a game from the genre of obstacle course passage. In this game you need to play as a cat to pass the map and get to the fish. Hardcore platformer challenges you, can you beat the game? The cats are waiting for you to go only forward!

title: Neon Snake
description: A fast-paced arcade snake game with neon visuals, combo multipliers, power-ups, and global leaderboards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

title: Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!
description:
🌟 Welcome to "Crazy Downhill! Ragdoll Fall Down!" — an exciting online game with ragdoll physics, where every descent turns into a real adventure! Roll, tumble, dodge obstacles and prove that you are the best in this crazy race with epic falls and popular meme heroes!

If you like such popular games as "Deadly Slide!" or "Ragdoll Crash Test: Throw and Break!", then quickly click "Play" and enjoy the exciting gameplay.

🔥 Game features:
- Simple and intuitive controls
- Funny ragdoll physics: watch your hero tumble, break and get up again! 🤸
- Cartoon 3D graphics and funny animations make every fall even funnier
- Skin shop: play as Hagi Wagi, Stickman, Noob, Obby and other popular heroes
- Compete in the leaderboard and show the best result
- Online game for any device: smartphone, PC or tablet

title: Color Dash - Chameleon Runner
description:
Run, jump, and switch colors to survive! Fast-paced endless runner challenge.

Get ready for a fast and challenging color-changing adventure in Chameleon Runner: Color Dash!
Run through vibrant worlds, switch your chameleon’s color at the right moment, and avoid obstacles that match the environment. Your reflexes are your greatest weapon!

Race through endless levels where speed increases, colors shift, and platforms test your timing. Collect gems, unlock skins, and climb the global high-score leaderboard. Simple to play, hard to master — perfect for players of all ages.

✨ Features

🎨 Color-switch gameplay — tap to change colors and match the world

⚡ Fast-paced endless running and reflex challenges

🦎 Unlock chameleon skins & effects

🌍 Multiple themed worlds: jungle, neon city, crystal cave


If you enjoy endless runners, color switch games, or skill-based platformers, this is your next favorite.

Download Chameleon Runner: Color Dash and master the color rhythm! 🦎💨

title: Space Obby
description: A fun and lighthearted platformer set in outer space. Join other intrepid astronauts as you adventure to the far reaching corners of a destroyed space station, using your trusty jetpack to navigate the floating wreckage. Featuring six unlockable characters and collectable battery cells scattered across four massive levels -- do you have what it takes to reach the end?

title: Capyballra - Capybara Ball Collector!
description:
Rotate the maze, roll to collect, unlock cute skins!

Twist the maze with your mouse or your finger, send your capyballas rolling into the pipe. Simple one-touch controls, snappy physics, and clever level design make every run satisfying. Use coins to unlock new Capyballra skins—classic, seasonal, and rare animated variants—to show off your favorites.

Perfect for quick runs or chasing full-collection completion: rotate, collect, unlock.

title: About a Frog
description: A puzzle game about a frog in which you need to pass various obstacles to activate the sail on a small raft to advance further.

title: Neon Ball Slope
description:
If you love fast-paced runner-type endless games, then you'll definitely love Neon Ball Slope!
It combines fast reactions with physics-based ball maneuvering. It'll start easy, but as you roll down the slope, it only gets steeper from there! Avoid obstacles, and collect coins and gems to invest into upgrade packs for cards to become more powerful and earn higher scores. Gain XP on runs to level up and the increase card amounts gained from packs and unlock content. Complete missions to get gems and equipment chests. Participate in the daily leaderboards and gain coins by getting the highest score out of your division!

title: Red-Blue Forge
description:
Red-Blue Forge is a fast reaction arcade game where you rotate core orbs to match incoming embers and survive as long as possible. Start in classic 2-core mode (Red/Blue), then unlock 4-core mode (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow) for higher intensity and a x3 score multiplier. The game features smooth touch/mouse controls, quick sessions, and a “Ready” start gate so each run begins on your command.

Between runs, collected materials feed a persistent Forge Tree progression system. Temper upgrades to improve control, stability, scoring bonuses, and long-run mastery. Every match rewards precision and timing, while long-term progression gives players clear goals and replay value. Ideal for mobile and desktop, Red-Blue Forge combines skill-based gameplay, readable visuals, and satisfying build progression in short, addictive runs.

title: Grand Escape!
description: Join the adventure of Grand Escape!, a thrilling online platform game. Discover a fascinating realm filled with odd beings and exciting challenges. Guide your character to triumph while navigating vibrant levels. Enjoy this free game on your computer or mobile device and embrace your adventurous spirit!

title: Arrow Pop
description:
Arrow Pop is a fast-paced hyper-casual archery game where every shot counts! 🎯

Aim with precision, hit colorful targets, and clear increasingly challenging stages packed with moving obstacles, tricky angles, and satisfying chain reactions. Unlock new bows, improve your accuracy, and master your timing as you pop every target in your way.

Easy to learn but hard to master, Arrow Pop delivers quick, addictive gameplay that's perfect for short breaks or long high-score sessions. Can you become the ultimate archer?

Features

🏹 Simple one-tap controls
🎯 Hundreds of fun and challenging levels
⚡ Smooth, satisfying shooting mechanics

Collect biomass to boost your jump, unlock new stages of evolution, and use a mid-air jump when ordinary amoeba determination is no longer enough. Every run is a chance to beat your personal record for height, time, and collected biomass.

Move around the area, swallow objects, and expand your size as you consume more items.

Start small by absorbing tiny goods, shelves, and carts. As your hole grows bigger, you’ll be able to swallow larger objects and clear the market faster. The more you consume, the stronger and bigger your hole becomes.

Simple controls, satisfying growth, and smooth gameplay make HoleMart perfect for quick play sessions and endless fun.

PONGOAL is an exciting fusion of classic Pong and high-stakes football action! Experience the timeless paddle gameplay you love, reimagined with the energy and intensity of a penalty shootout. A fragile egg begins a dangerous journey toward the sky. The world around you is unstable — steep slopes, sharp edges, and tricky obstacles that can crack your shell at any moment.

You can collect coins during runs and use them to unlock new characters. The game is built for short sessions: the rules are simple, but the speed and direction changes quickly make every run tense.

Fast-paced arcade shooter where every tap fires your weapon and flips it through the air, turning recoil into movement. Master ricochets, chain precise shots, and stay in control as you bounce around the screen in chaotic, skill-based action.

Switch between different weapons like SMGs and shotguns, each with unique feel and strategy, and adapt on the fly to survive longer. Grab powerful upgrades such as rockets for explosive shots and shields for protection, adding depth to every run.

Simple to learn but hard to master, the game delivers nonstop action, satisfying mechanics, and endless replayability.

title: Color Match Rush
description:
Color Match Rush is a lightning-fast, one-thumb reflex arcade game built for quick sessions
and high-score obsession. A glowing ring of colored segments spins at the center of the
screen while colored dots rush inward toward a fixed gate at the top. Your only job sounds
simple: rotate the ring so the segment under the gate matches the color of the incoming dot.
Nail it and your score climbs; pick the wrong color even once and the run is over. There are
no second chances — just you, your reflexes, and the next dot closing in.
What makes Color Match Rush so addictive is how the pressure ramps up. You start with four
colors and a calm pace, but

title: Spaceball Jump

Spaceball Jump is a thrilling, physics-based arcade game where you must navigate a glowing astronaut ball through a treacherous and beautiful galaxy. Your goal is simple: hop from planet to planet, collect all the golden stars, and unlock the portal to warp to the next sector!

But space is full of dangers. You'll need to time your leaps perfectly to utilize the rotational momentum of the planets while avoiding deadly orbital spikes, giant death stars, and the endless void of space. With 25 levels of increasing difficulty—featuring moving platforms, chaotic planetary clusters, and tight precision jumps—do you have what it takes to conquer the galaxy?


Features

Orbital Physics: Use the spin of the planets to slingshot yourself across space.

Hazards & Collectibles: Dodge spinning spike walls and collect 3 stars in every level to open the escape portal!
